name: Funeral Potatoes
time: ~1 hr 45 min, ~40 min hands-on (mostly baking; estimated)

steps.title: Boil and shred
steps.body: Boil, peel, and shred, then place in 9×13 pan: **5 large potatoes**.

steps.title: Add the butter
steps.body: Melt and pour over potatoes: **3 Tbsp melted butter**.

steps.title: Add the sauce
steps.body: Mix and pour over top: **1 can cream of chicken soup**, **1 cup sour cream**, **3 Tbsp green onions**, sliced, and **3 Tbsp parmesan cheese**.

steps.title: Add the topping
steps.body: Mix and sprinkle over casserole: **¾ cup corn flake crumbs** and **2 Tbsp melted butter**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake in the oven until heated through. 350°F for an hour or, if you have a long funeral, 250°F semi-indefinitely. For cremation potatoes, maximize oven temperature and bake for 24 hours.
